tools.name: search_curators
tools.description: Find Steam curators by name. Use it when someone names a curator (for example one that emailed them asking for a key) and you need its Curator Match id. Matching ignores case, spacing and punctuation, and a part of the name is enough. A Steam curator link or id also works. Returns up to ten curators

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_curator_list_link, get_curator · Private data: get_curator_list_link · Public sink: get_curator_list_link, find_curators_for_games, get_curator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_curator_list_link, get_curator · Private data: get_curator_list_link · Public sink: get_curator_list_link, find_curators_for_games, get_curator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
